data.title: South Beach Holiday Homes
data.about:
Introducing Emaar’s first-ever holiday homes in Dubai! South Beach Holiday Homes with property management services from Ease by Emaar. Fully furnished 1, 2, 3 bedroom Miami-styled apartments overlooking the sea. A dual-purpose apartment is the perfect investment opportunity.

The holiday home apartments have beautiful aquamarine and sandy hues inside. Thus bringing the beach to your home. Mesmerising views of the Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are all around. Located on Dubai Harbour, between Jumeirah Beach Residences and Palm Jumeirah, these apartments have the best connectivity with the city via nearby monorail, tram, metro and RTA boat station, and a short drive to Sheikh Zayed Road to get to the airport. The nearby business districts of Dubai Internet City and Dubai Media City are minutes away. The island is located at the Dubai Harbour which includes Skydive Dubai, Dubai International Marine Club & Logo Island.

location_tile.title: A city address on an island, South Beach Holiday Homes in Dubai have the perfect location.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Situated between Jumeirah Beach Residences and Palm Jumeirah, the most iconic landmarks are just minutes away. Close to Yacht clubs and International Marine Club, these holiday homes have access to the 1.5km of pristine beach.

  • 5 minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 5 minutes to The Palm
  • 25 minutes to Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa
  • 25 minutes to Dubai Intl. Airport
  • 35 minutes to Expo 2020
  • 45 minutes – Al Maktoum Intl. Airport
